---
title: "Notation"
---

This appendix will collect symbols used across chapters.

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $x = x_1x_2\ldots x_n$ | Sequence of length $n$ |
| $|x|$ | Length of sequence $x$ |
| $\Sigma$ | Finite alphabet |
| $s(a,b)$ | Score for aligning symbols $a$ and $b$ |
| $\mathcal{O}(\cdot)$ | Asymptotic growth rate |
